Name: Quaint Living - Flower Garden 2
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
Hey there! SDV 1.6 is here, and I'm delighted to introduce Quaint Living - Flower Garden 2: a remake of Quaint Living - Flower Garden mod made for Stardew Valley 1.6 featuring 18 crops (with more vanilla-friendly, non-convoluted names...) and 4 flower trees.
This mod adds:

[u]Crops[/u]:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*] Amaryllis (winter, Year 2)
[*] Calla Lily (summer, Year 2)
[*] Carnation (summer, fall, Year 3)
[*] Dahlia (spring, fall)
[*]Delphinium (summer)
[*] Freesia (spring)
[*] Fritillaria (spring)
[*] Iris (spring, summer, fall)
[*] Jasmine (spring, summer, Year 2, Sold at Sandy)
[*] Lavender (fall, Year 2)
[*] Lily (summer)
[*] Orchid (summer, Year 3)
[*] Pansy (spring, winter)
[*] Peony (spring)
[*] Rose (spring, summer, fall, Year 2)
[*] Snapdragon (fall, winter, Year 2)
[*] Striped Squill (spring, winter, Year 2)
[*] Zinnia (summer, fall)
[/list]
[/spoiler]

[u]Trees:[/u]
[list]
[spoiler][*] Alamanda (summer, Year 2)
[*] Gardenia (summer)
[*] Hibiscus (summer)
[*] Lilac (spring)
[/list]
[/spoiler]


[u]Notes[/u]:[*] Giant flowers are available for Calla Lily, Dahlia, Delphinium, Iris, Lily, Rose, and Striped Squill.
[*] Seasonal variation for some flowers that grow in multiple seasons (Dahlia, Iris, Lily, Rose) is available, default is true. Can be toggled off in SeasonalVariant config.

[/spoiler]

[u]Future Plans[/u]:
[*]Adds flower-derived artisan goods, craftables and furniture ( most likely in separate mods)
[*]Tilesheet version (in the works)

And that's it. I absolutely adore flowers, and it brings me so much joy to be able to grow my favorites on my pixelated SDV farm. I hope you enjoy them too.

Happy gardening!
